title: Readability measurements preserve distinct DOM targets and reject unproven repair locations
steps: Run run.cmd without Docker, a server or a model provider.
Verify all eight tests execute with zero failures and zero skips.
expect: Four measurements of one complete target become one repair retaining every width and theme observation.
Three equal email nodes sharing a coarse baseline key remain three independently resolved DOM targets.
Duplicate IDs, changed text or ownership and missing legacy target metadata remain unresolved without native comment requests.
Nested inline text retains browser textContent identity without inserting spaces between child nodes; real text changes still remain unresolved.
The actual delivered comment names the verified selector for page.look and look.set, carries every observation, and prohibits guessed occurrence indices or consent bypass.
Oversized paths, words or provenance marks and incomplete target metadata never authorize a repair.

tests: four width and theme observations of one proven element become one repair retaining all observations
three identical emails with one coarse key remain three independently verified DOM targets
duplicate IDs cannot turn an ambiguous measured path into a chosen email
fresh text or ownership changes leave measured text unresolved without a content lookup
unchanged nested inline text resolves using browser textContent while real text changes stay blocked
an unproven legacy diagnostic never becomes a body comment or a guessed occurrence
one verified repair comment carries all measurements and forbids guessed occurrence indices or consent bypass
oversized or incomplete target metadata remains unresolved without a guessed repair
